class.name: GsqPagedChunkPayloadSource
class.brief_description: File-backed [ChunkPayloadSource] for worlds stored as compressed GSQ pages.
class.description: A [ChunkPayloadSource] for [code].gsplatworld[/code] files whose chunks are runs of GSQ v1 pages. Only the page directory is kept resident. A capture reads the pages it needs on a reader pool, checks each page against its directory entry and stored digest, and decodes it on the calling thread, which on the streaming route is a pack worker. A source can also re-hash each decoded page against its recorded decoded digest; a world loaded for streaming does not, because the stored digest and the zstd frame checksums already cover every stored byte. A page that fails a check fails the capture with a reason; nothing is repaired.

method.name: get_decode_stats
method.description: Returns the source's counters: captures, failed captures, pages and splats decoded, decode time in nanoseconds ([code]decode_nsec[/code]) with its stored-page verify ([code]verify_nsec[/code]) and decoded-digest ([code]digest_nsec[/code], null when decoded-reference verification was not performed) shares, whether the decoded digest is checked ([code]decoded_digest_verified[/code]) and on how many pages it was ([code]pages_decoded_digest_checked[/code]), pages decoded on worker threads and on the main thread, page failures with the last failure reason, and the read pool's request and byte counters. The exported [code]digest_status[/code] describes verification against an in-format decoded reference: [code]checked[/code], [code]skipped[/code] by chunk policy, [code]not_available[/code] when the format has no decoded reference (V4), [code]mixed[/code] for multiple categories, or [code]not_performed[/code] before any successful decode. Checked, skipped, and unavailable page counters sum to decoded pages. Independently, enabling [code]rendering/gaussian_splatting/diagnostics/payload_content_digests[/code] before source startup collects [code]content_digests[/code]: source-local decimal page/node IDs mapped to canonical decoded Gaussian and SH SHA-256 hex. V4 leaf digests use reconstructed absolute positions. This bounded diagnostic map is empty by default and is reset on source replacement. A runtime digest does not imply verification against an in-format reference.
